Nick Jonas wishes Priyanka Chopra a happy 44th birthday

Nick Jonas shared a video from their Spain vacation to celebrate Priyanka Chopra's 44th birthday. He conveyed his wishes in a romantic manner, and Chopra responded with a flying kiss. The event highlights a personal celebration of a prominent Indian actress.
